title: Trap-Engineered Optoelectronic Memristors
question: How can an intermediate layer improve low-power optoelectronic memory?
mechanism: An ALD TiO₂ nanofilm passivates perovskite-interface defects and improves electron-transport alignment.
approach: Compare trap density and switching behavior in devices with and without the intermediate layer.
evidence: Electrical and optical device characterization; 5 × 5 array image-recognition evaluation.
achievement: 15× lower interfacial trap density · +0.24 V SET · ≈0.7 µW switching power.
myContribution: First author of the published study.
outcome: The intermediate layer reduced trap density and enabled low-voltage nonvolatile memory, optical sensing, and logic demonstrations.
